# Secrets and Document Vault

> A credential and document store. Everything past the sign-in screen requires an account, and no
> secret value is ever served in HTML.

## Pages

- [Sign in](https://vault.example.org/login): the only page an anonymous visitor can read.
- [Vault status](https://vault.example.org/status): whether the API is answering.

## Notes

- The workbench exposes WebMCP tools for listing, searching and opening secrets by name.
- Revealing, exporting and deleting are deliberately not available to an agent.
